quarantine.reason: origin/main carries the pre-fix upstream pair: backend/utils/conversations/projection_payload.py imports models.client_processing at module scope, while backend/tests/unit/test_batch_upload_storage.py and test_merge_validation.py stub `models` without that submodule, so every run fails with ModuleNotFoundError. upstream/main already fixed both sides (the stub list includes models.client_processing and the import moved into the function). backend/** is a T2 never-modify path, so the remedy is the next upstream sync, not a fork edit.
